spec_basis.STU-RAS-144: StudioChannel.kind is closed: component = 1, masked_area_alpha = 2, selected_area_alpha = 3, spot_colour = 4. The two alpha kinds differ in polarity and MUST NOT be merged ... a spot channel carries solidity in percent

notes.polarity_reading: samples = panel tone (0 black); coverage = tone for masked_area_alpha, 1 - tone for selected_area_alpha and spot_colour; kind conversion inverts samples only across polarity (Studio reading of STU-RAS-144; Photoshop UNVERIFIED, D5)
